name: Computational Materials Repository (CMR)
description: DTU portal for project-specific ASE databases spanning low-dimensional materials, bulk crystals, perovskites, surfaces and related benchmarks. Provides project documentation, browser routes, downloadable databases and an OPTIMADE route. Provider states CMR databases use CC BY-SA 4.0. Portal totals are not an additional crystal dataset.

sources.title: CMR official portal
sources.evidence: Defines each project as an ASE database with a project page and browse/download access; links an OPTIMADE endpoint and states all CMR databases are CC BY-SA 4.0.

sources.title: 2DHub official portal
sources.evidence: Current home for C2DB and related 2D databases, links back to CMR; these named datasets are already separate catalog records.

name: Organic Materials Database (OMDB)
description: Electronic and magnetic information portal for periodic organic and organometallic crystals, including band structures, DOS and magnetic-excitation tools. Named downloads distinguish DFT-labelled OMDB-GAP1 from COD model predictions. Public browsing is limited and named downloads currently redirect to free-registration login; a current full-family count and dataset-wide reuse license were not verified.

sources.title: OMDB provider description
sources.evidence: Describes an organic/organometallic electronic-structure database with DFT and advanced query tools.

sources.title: OMDB named data releases
sources.evidence: Lists the 12,500-material OMDB-GAP1 and 260,092-material COD prediction releases as distinct products.

sources.title: OMDB terms
sources.evidence: Terms mention access quotas but do not identify a general data reuse license.

sources.title: OMDB public materials browser
sources.evidence: Anonymous browser explicitly limits visible data and offers free registration; the page-local displayed totals are not adopted as a full-family count.

name: MaterialsWeb
description: Hennig-group portal historically covering calculated 2D materials, bulk materials and computational benchmarks. Author paper released an 826-monolayer cohort in 2017. Current host failed TLS access in the 2026-11-01 audit, so live browsing, bulk downloads, current totals and data reuse rights remain unverified.

sources.title: Hennig Materials Theory Lab resources
sources.evidence: Provider lab explicitly links MaterialsWeb routes for 2D and bulk materials.

sources.title: Topology-Scaling Identification of Layered Solids and Stable Exfoliated 2D Materials
sources.evidence: Author paper identifies 826 monolayers and says optimized structures and related data were provided at MaterialsWeb; this is a historical paper cohort.

sources.title: MaterialsWeb direct access check
sources.evidence: Requested HTTPS host could not be fetched by the web tool; independent standard urllib access reported a TLS unrecognized-name failure for www and bare host.
